title: DKA, home; template summary with empty diagnosis, PCP and goals sections and no course, condition, disposition, function or planning evaluation

rationale.final_diagnosis: The Discharge Diagnosis header is present but empty; DKA appears only in the case title, not the record.
rationale.hospital_course: There is no hospital course section and no narrative of what was treated or the outcome.
rationale.discharge_condition: Condition at discharge is not stated anywhere.
rationale.disposition: The disposition hint (Home) comes from the registration system; no document states where she was discharged to.
rationale.pcp_named: The Primary Care Provider header is empty and the only follow-up is with a clinic, not a named clinician.
rationale.goals_of_care: The Goals of Care header is empty; there is no code status or stated treatment preference.
rationale.functional_status: No description of mobility or daily-activity function.
rationale.dp_evaluation: No discharge planning evaluation of post-hospital needs is documented.
rationale.followup: Follow-up names a clinic (who) and a date and time (when), which satisfies the rule even though no individual clinician is named.
rationale.dp_discussed: The insulin and sick-day plan, the substance of this discharge plan, was reviewed with the patient and her mother.
rationale.pac_list: Not referred to home health, SNF, IRF or LTCH, so the three post-acute rules do not apply.
rationale.meds_consistent: No nursing discharge instructions were provided, so there is nothing to compare.
